input.summary: Add Vendor defence/indemnity for IP, legal breach, data breach and wilful misconduct with claim procedure, and narrow Customer's indemnity.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 20 currently gives Vendor a one-way indemnity for "every claim" relating to our use of the Services and contains no Vendor indemnity at all. We have added the Vendor defence and indemnity for IP infringement, breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused data breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct with a standard notice/control/cooperation procedure, and narrowed our indemnity to Customer-provided content and our breach of law.

ops.oldText: Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services.
ops.newText: Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from third-party claims to the extent arising out of Customer-provided content or Customer's breach of Applicable Law.

ops.text: Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer and its Affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs, and expenses, to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Services or any Deliverable infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right; (b) Vendor's breach of Applicable Law; (c) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor; or (d) Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. The indemnified Party shall give the indemnifying Party notice of the claim, the indemnifying Party shall control the defence, and the indemnified Party shall provide reasonable cooperation.
